demonstration.narration: I'll compare the underlying latency below and above that throughput level to estimate where it changes.
demonstration.reasoning: A chart bucket shows that latency is high, not where it starts rising. Reading the records on both sides of the change brackets the threshold.
demonstration.evidence: Requests at 180 requests/second stay near 220 ms while those at 240 take about 1.2 s, so the saturation point lies between them, around ${truth.finding}. ${truth.conclusion}
